notes.title: Roadmap until the Steam release
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]Today I want to share with you the development roadmap for [b]Shattered Dreams: Redemption[/b] over the next few months, all the way to its release on Steam.[/p][p]I can officially announce that the [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3567910/Shattered_Dreams_Redemption/"]early access release on Steam[/url] is scheduled for January 28, 2026[/b].[/p][p][i](This date will not change unless a major issue arises, and if that happens, I will inform you in advance.)[/i][/p][p]Now, here is the roadmap, with each step listed in chronological order:[/p][list][*][p][b]Release of a new trailer before the October Steam Neo Fest[/b][/p][list][*][p]This will be the official trailer for the early access release of [i]Shattered Dreams: Redemption[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]October Steam Neo Fest – From October 13 to October 20[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Shattered Dreams: Redemption[/i] will participate in the October Neo Fest, where you’ll be able to try out the free SFW demo on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]The demo will go live a few days before the Neo Fest begins and will remain available for one month.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Steam build preparation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam release (version 0.6) on January 28, 2026[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Release of Version 0.7 after the Steam release[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ideally, it will come out in February.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]That’s the plan for the next few months — there’s a lot to prepare for the Steam launch.[/p][p]The Steam release is really important to me and to the game, and that’s why I keep repeating it: [/p][p][b]The best way to support the game is to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3567910/Shattered_Dreams_Redemption/"]wishlist it on Steam[/url] if you haven’t already, or to talk about it to your friends[/b].[/p][p]Whether it’s one or the other, don’t hesitate — those small actions help a lot![/p][p]That’s all for this post. Before I go, I want to thank you once again for all the support you give the game — you have no idea how much it means to me.[/p][p]With that said, see you next time ![/p]

notes.title: Some information about what's coming for Shattered Dreams: Redemption
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

I wanted to share a few updates about what’s coming in the next few months for the game leading up to its Early Access release.

First of all, barring any last-minute issues, I’ll be participating in the Steam Next Fest this October, where you’ll be able to try out the game’s demo—months ahead of its official release. I’m really looking forward to your first impressions, and I hope the demo will give you a taste of what’s to come in Early Access!

Next, development is progressing at a solid pace. The plan is for the game to launch in Early Access with version 0.7 (note: version 1.0 won’t be the final version—there will be a 1.1, 1.2, and so on). As of now, I’ve just begun work on version 0.5, and everything is right on schedule. At the end of this post, you’ll find a few preview images from version 0.4 and 0.5.

Lastly, the current trailer will be updated in the coming months—ideally before the Steam Next Fest, but if not, sometime in November or December.  

That’s all for now! I’ll try to post updates every month or two to keep you informed on the progress as we move closer to the Early Access launch.

Have a great day![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549865/c1d5fb32b00cfa7d9cfecbbac56069974fd96222.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549865/5f1a19a689ddbbbd48d0770ef798935e6426b93f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549865/892a3a5b12459cbea138ed24e5a9c72a539b4bd0.png"][/img][/p]
